items.note: No assessment of gate approach velocity, fish-screen limit, or relocating screens is provided.
Correctly finds 14-15 mgd firm capacity but proposes rehabilitating Pump 3 plus unspecified added capacity rather than replacing Pump 1 with a 6 mgd VFD pump.
Correctly identifies the 12 mgd treatment limit despite somewhat higher hydraulic capacity and recommends a second parallel basin.
Correctly recommends two new filters and re-piping filter-to-waste from about 2 mgd to the full roughly 4 mgd filter rate.
Agent flags the clearwell as limiting and requiring CT proof or possible added storage, opposite the engineers' conclusion that it is adequate to 18 mgd with no change.
Correctly finds about 10 mgd nominal and 11.2 mgd tested firm capacity and adds two pumps in the open slots, but specifies two 2800 gpm pumps rather than 4 mgd and 6 mgd VFD pumps.
Correctly identifies the 14 mgd surge-tank limit but only calls for a new transient study and possible upsizing rather than replacement with a larger tank.
